comments.text: I wrote this email to a client of mine that I tutor her son: {Hi Kristy
Please see the attached invoice for Hank's tutoring lessons in Term 2, 2023.

As Hank has been attending regular weekly lessons specifically in preparation for the upcoming selective tests, my understanding is that Hank will no longer require my ongoing weekly assistance beyond 1 May 2023.

I would therefore like to take this opportunity to extend my heartfelt gratitude to you for entrusting me with Hank's education. It has been a pleasure working with Hank again over the past few months, and I am grateful for the opportunity to have been a part of his academic journey. I hope that the skills and knowledge Hank has gained during our sessions will continue to serve him well in his future studies.
I welcome you to reach out if you would like Hank to continue with weekly tutoring lessons in Term 2 or if you need any further assistance in the future.
Thank you} And I received this response: {Thank you Marco,

Hank is keen to continue Tutoring for all of term 2. But maybe we could chat about what that would look like - in terms of lesson plans and goals - I just think the Selective test has motivated his engagement so would just want him to understand the goals so he doesnt' drift off.} Your task is to write a thorough response to this email acting as Marco, a professional business owner and head tutor of an excellent Primary and High School Tutoring business, that wishes for Hank to continue lessons with him. Marco appreciates Hank's enthusiasm for wanting to better his learning.
